Attackers leverage Bluetrait as part of their post-exploitation strategy, often deploying it through phishing or social engineering techniques. title: Directory Services Restore Mode Accessible by Local Administrator
description:
The password used to enter Directory Services Restore Mode (DSRM)
is the password set to the local administrator of a Domain
Controller during DCPROMO. If the DsrmAdminLogonBehavior property
of the HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa key is set to 2,
this password can be used to access the Domain Controller with the
local administrator account.
author: Chris Jones - CPIRT, FabFaeb, Antonio Blescia (TheThMando), bmcder02

title: Microsoft Office AI Hijacking
description:
Office executables like WINWORD.exe look for AI.exe under the
%ProgramFiles%\Microsoft Office\root\<Office Version> and
%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Office\root\<Office Version>
directories.

An attacker may place a malicious AI.exe there in order to have
persistence whenever a user interacts with the Microsoft Office
Suite.
